description:
Title: OEE

Write a process, that collects relevant information from a machine, and calculated the Overall Equipment Efficiency (OEE).
If the OEE falls below a certain value/percentage, stop the machine and send an email to an engineer.
When the machine is restarted, continue measuring.
When the machine is disconnected, stop the process.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_OEE"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/oee">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineInformation" name="Machine information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineStopCommand" name="Machine stop command"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EngineerEmail" name="Engineer email"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OEE">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OEE" name="OEE" processRef="Process_OEE"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Machine" name="Machine"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Engineer" name="Engineer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MachineInformation"
                      name="Machine information"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Machine"
                      targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"
                      messageRef="Message_MachineInformation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StopMachine"
                      name="Stop machine"
                      sourceRef="Task_StopMachine"
                      targetRef="Participant_Machine"
                      messageRef="Message_MachineStopCommand"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EngineerEmail"
                      name="Email engineer"
                      sourceRef="Task_EmailEngineer"
                      targetRef="Participant_Engineer"
                      messageRef="Message_EngineerEmail"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MachineRestarted"
                      name="Machine restarted"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Machine"
                      targetRef="Event_MachineRestarted"
                      messageRef="Message_MachineRestarted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MachineDisconnectedDuringWait"
                      name="Machine disconnected"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Machine"
                      targetRef="Event_MachineDisconnectedDuringWait"
                      messageRef="Message_MachineDisconnected"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MachineDisconnectedDuringCollection"
                      name="Machine disconnected"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Machine"
                      targetRef="Event_MachineDisconnectedDuringCollection"
                      messageRef="Message_MachineDisconnected"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OEE" name="OEE" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OEE" name="Start OEE monitoring">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToCollect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect machine information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToCollect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ThresholdToCollect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RestartToCollect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectToCalculate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Event_MachineDisconnectedDuringCollection"
                        name="Machine disconnected"
                        attachedToRef="Task_CollectInformation"
                        cancelActivity="true">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DisconnectedDuringCollectionToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DisconnectedDuringCollection"
                                  messageRef="Message_MachineDisconnected"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CalculateOEE" name="Calculate OEE">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectToCalculate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CalculateToThreshold</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OEEThreshold"
                           name="OEE below threshold?"
                           default="Flow_ThresholdToCollect">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CalculateToThreshold</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ThresholdToStop</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ThresholdToCollect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_StopMachine"
                   name="Stop machine"
                   messageRef="Message_MachineStopCommand">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ThresholdToStop</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StopToEmail</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmailEngineer"
                   name="Email engineer"
                   messageRef="Message_EngineerEmail">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StopToEmail</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EmailToWait</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForRestartOrDisconnect"
                            name="Wait for restart or disconnection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EmailToWait</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WaitToRestart</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WaitToDisconnected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WaitToRestart</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RestartToCollect</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_MachineRestarted"
                                  messageRef="Message_MachineRestarted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_MachineDisconnectedDuringWait"
                                 name="Machine disconnected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WaitToDisconnected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DisconnectedDuringWaitToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DisconnectedDuringWait"
                                  messageRef="Message_MachineDisconnected"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Process" name="Process stopped">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DisconnectedDuringCollectionToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DisconnectedDuringWaitToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToCollect"
                       sourceRef="Start_OEE"
                       targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectToCalculate"
                       sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation"
                       targetRef="Task_CalculateOEE"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CalculateToThreshold"
                       sourceRef="Task_CalculateOEE"
                       targetRef="Gateway_OEEThreshold"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThresholdToStop"
                       name="Below threshold"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_OEEThreshold"
                       targetRef="Task_StopMachine">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">OEE < threshold</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThresholdToCollect"
                       name="Not below threshold"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_OEEThreshold"
                       targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StopToEmail"
                       sourceRef="Task_StopMachine"
                       targetRef="Task_EmailEngineer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmailToWait"
                       sourceRef="Task_EmailEngineer"
                       targetRef="Gateway_WaitForRestartOrDisconnect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitToRestart"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForRestartOrDisconnect"
                       targetRef="Event_MachineRestarted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitToDisconnected"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForRestartOrDisconnect"
                       targetRef="Event_MachineDisconnectedDuringWait"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RestartToCollect"
                       sourceRef="Event_MachineRestarted"
                       targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DisconnectedDuringCollectionToEnd"
                       sourceRef="Event_MachineDisconnectedDuringCollection"
                       targetRef="End_Process"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DisconnectedDuringWaitToEnd"
                       sourceRef="Event_MachineDisconnectedDuringWait"
                       targetRef="End_Process"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
